readme_constraints: 1. Buttons/cards are outline/border style. No solid accent fill (source: Classical readme, "Do not fill cards or buttons with solid accent color.")
2. No heavy shadows -- elevation is a "whisper" level. Use only --shadow-sm/md/lg, do not invent new shadows.
3. Body text is justified where layout allows. Do not tighten line-height or spacing -- the spacing scale is intentionally airy (1.15x).

4. Focus ring: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }. One conflicting hardcoded style found and flagged for removal: src/components/product/ProductCard.tsx:40 (focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-neutral-900 focus-visible:ring-offset-2). This is the only focus-style site in the repo (confirmed by grep during plan-phase).

5. Icons are Lucide -- DEFERRED, not introduced this SPEC (no lucide-react dependency exists; no icon usage in this SPEC's scope; AC-DESIGN-006 requires 0 new dependencies). Forward-pointer only (spec.md §4).
